ns2:section.sectionText: Students should only register for one section of FSHN 120. This online only section does not have a class meeting time. Students will use Canvas to watch recorded lectures and view assignments. *** You will receive a welcome email from the instructor with further instructions prior to the start of the semester. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/nutrition-fshn120/online-vs-in-house/ If you have any questions about the course, feel free to e-mail the lead instructor (Toni Gist) at burkhalt@Illinois.edu
